defs.def: to increase or further improve the good quality, value or status of sb/sth 提高；增强；增进adj.noun

ex.s: Scientists at Salk Institute are making use of the natural capacity of plants to absorb carbon dioxide by enhancing their root systems.
ex.t: 萨尔克研究所的科学家正在利用植物吸收二氧化碳的自然能力，通过增强其根系来实现这一目标。

ex.s: Enhance your photography skills — join Yellowstone’s park photographer for a hands-on program to inspire new and creative ways of enjoying the beauty and wonder of Yellowstone.
ex.t: 提升你的摄影技巧——加入黄石公园摄影师的实践项目，激发享受黄石之美与奇迹的新颖创意方式。

ex.s: The nature language enhances work performance.
ex.t: 自然语言能提高工作表现。

ex.s: At the core of Lancom is a world-class effective method that enhances language leaning with advanced technology.
ex.t: Lancom的核心是一种世界级的有效方法，借助先进技术提升语言学习。

ex.s: Spring has many beauties, and May is a fresh and blooming month, but the charms of this time of year are enhanced by their contrast with the winter season.
ex.t: 春天有很多美景，五月是一个清新而盛开的月份，但与冬季形成鲜明对比，增强了这一年中这个季节的魅力。

ex.s: Through economic development and enhanced communication, it aims to bring many benefits to the countries along its routes.
ex.t: 通过经济发展和加强交流，它旨在为沿线国家带来诸多好处。

ex.s: It has enhanced the quality of my life, improving my health and increasing my happiness.
ex.t: 它提高了我的生活质量，改善了我的健康，也增加了我的幸福感。

ex.s: Hundreds of years on, and with the latest technology in hand, the need to trade and the desire to enhance relationships will drive China to reach out across the sea far into the future.
ex.t: 几百年过去了，借助最先进的技术，贸易的需要和增进关系的愿望将推动中国跨越海洋，迈向遥远的未来。

ex.s: CRITICAL THINKING How have the four inventions enhanced the quality of life for humans?
ex.t: 批判性思考 这四项发明是如何提升人类生活质量的？
